task.description: Design tests for DSL-12 (Engine API). Create test spec at tests/specs/DSL-12.md covering: (1) Basic parse and evaluate flow, (2) Same ParsedExpr evaluated against different contexts yields different results, (3) Caching: parse, cache, re-evaluate same expression produces same result as new parse, (4) Error cases: invalid syntax, null context, (5) Concurrent access safety if applicable.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/DSL-12.md specifies all acceptance criteria as executable test scenarios
Tests cover both happy path (valid expressions) and edge cases (null, empty, malformed)
Caching behavior verified: same ParsedExpr evaluated twice yields identical results
Error handling specified (invalid syntax, runtime errors)
